description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 27.11.2017 to 03.12.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It exercises regulatory authority, rescinds a previous notification, and sets legally binding currency conversion rates, making it a clear example of legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
